dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: Hehe. It seems that the Truesight Potion has been marvelously successful. I think that quite a few enhanced formulas can be made, too... Vere can decide their exact proportions, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: Hmm? What is it? Would you like any potions made by yours truly?

dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: Well now, to think that you'd be interested in such. I suppose you're also one enthralled by "possibility." Good, good.

dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: You process ingredients that don't have any effects on their own, mix them together, and they'll turn into potions that can work in lots of different ways!

dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: It is a deed akin to using the impression things have given you in your memories, and combining them with flashes of inspiration to create new "realities."

dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: Even I do not know what the potioning possibilities are! This is the excitement of being a potioneer.

dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean Vere. She's an earnest girl, and she's been a great help to me in measuring potion proportions and conducting experiments.

dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: She's the only one who can help me complete said experiments...

dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: Ah, yes — she also names some of the products, the Truesight Potion being amongst them.

dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: That said, I do think that she's too straight-laced in her naming sense. I think something like my "Coasty-Toasty Potion" is cutesier...

dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: Ah, and here I thought you were going to test the potions. Oh well... Err, I mean, you're always welcome to drop by!
